# Daily Research reference

Daily Research generates a Japanese morning edition to help a reader encounter unfamiliar possibilities, examples and questions. Immediate applicability to a repository is optional.

## Runtime

scripts/daily-research.sh accepts --preview, --date YYYY-MM-DD, and --config PATH.
The configured defaults use Claude Opus for exploration (1500 seconds / 55 turns) and editorial (1200 seconds / 45 turns). Sessions run in a dedicated directory with --safe-mode and WebSearch/WebFetch tools. They return structured JSON. scripts/lib/discovery.py is the source of truth for configuration and output schemas, validation, rendering and history.

Exploration receives the date, reader profile and self-signals. Editorial receives the date, reader profile, research packet and recent 30-day edition index. Both may research the web. The reader profile is not automatically changed by generated material. Model output and external documents are untrusted data.

## Output

A normal edition contains one main article and up to three briefs, usually two. Main length guidance is 1800–2600 Japanese characters; brief guidance is 200–400. Briefs-only and quiet editions are valid editorial choices. Quiet means insufficient interesting material, not an execution error.

Published notes use YYYY-MM-DD_discovery_edition.md with date/category/tags/topic/sources/actionable frontmatter and a ソース section. 機会メモ appears only for a sourced actual deadline. Quiet notices remain private. Preview does not publish or update production history/wiki. Only newly published current-day editions invoke wiki ingest. Same-date reruns must not create duplicate notes or duplicate wiki ingestion.

## Evaluation and archives

After seven days, ask the reader what they wanted to follow, what started a thought and what felt repetitive. Inspect saved candidates to locate search versus editorial problems. Article count, source count and repository-return count do not measure interest. Historical playbooks, graphs and ADRs are retained as archives, not injected into ordinary exploration. graph.jsonld is frozen.

See README.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, docs/CONTRIB.md, and docs/adr/0016-discovery-first-edition.md for setup, operations, tests and rationale.
